[component:comp.lot.travels_with.1] Closed at 13:11 by 'they separated, each from his brother'.

[component:comp.abraham.dwelling.3] Numbered 3 and 4 because GEN.12 already holds dwelling.1 and .2. Inferred from 'Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan' (v12); a coarse state replaced at v18 by dwelling at Mamre.
[component:comp.abraham.promised_land.1] Left open: the promise of 12:7 is restated and widened here (13:15 all the land seen, 'for ever'), not replaced.
